DML.SELECT: SELECT element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_type_param_id as "elementTypeParamId", param_type_id as "paramTypeId", element_id as "elementId", element_value_state_id as "elementValueStateId", value as "value", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.element_values WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null UNION SELECT element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_type_param_id as "elementTypeParamId", param_type_id as "paramTypeId", element_id as "elementId", element_value_state_id as "elementValueStateId", value as "value", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM rt.element_values WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.element_values (element_type_id, element_type_param_id, param_type_id, element_id, element_value_state_id, value, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:elementTypeId, :elementTypeParamId, :paramTypeId, :elementId, :elementValueStateId, :value, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.element_values SET element_value_state_id = :elementValueStateId, value = :value, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND element_type_param_id = :elementTypeParamId AND param_type_id = :paramTypeId AND element_id = :elementId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.element_values WHERE element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND element_type_param_id = :elementTypeParamId AND param_type_id = :paramTypeId AND element_id = :elementId
